data.spec: Local photo-informed approximate 3D cutaway, self-contained OfficeTwin.tsx/officeScene.ts/office-twin.css plus twin device editor files. Physical demo button shown on stage in front of burgundy chairs at scene(-5.65,6.7), defaults station_id:kitchen. Actual bridge maps serial event_type:'button',key:<observed firmware key>,value:true via --mapping JSON key→station (not --station, which is simulator-only); existing POST /api/device-events drives authoritative station request state. No device identity/connected hardware inferred. Users may add/name/map/reposition 3D buttons and simulated level sensors; browser-only layout config persists in localStorage, not hardware firmware. Sensor levels explicitly simulated. No API/shared schema changes; exact approval fingerprint/event paths retained. Component separate for agent-interface-design merge.
